items.item_text: B.S. degree or equivalent in Biomedical Engineering, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, or related field.

The Shoucri Laboratory is recruiting a research associate to perform mouse and tissue culture experiments in the field of adipose biology. Candidates must have relevant experience in adipocyte cell culture models, managing genetic mouse lines, and metabolic phenotyping of mice.
This is a limited position that may convert to career.
Willingness to accommodate a flexible work schedule, including occasional overtime to meet deadlines.
Knowledge of standard laboratory equipment, supplies and basic molecular biology techniques
Knowledge of IRB protocols and applications and University procedures
Good communication skills and ability to work well with multiple individuals
Ability to maintain a clean and organized working area
Ability to keep accurate and organized lab records
Knowledge of chemistry to prepare solutions for lab experiments, and laboratory safety procedures for handling chemical and biohazard waste
Working knowledge and ability in the use of computers (PC and MAC operating systems)
Skill in using various computer software. Specifically: R, R Studio, SPSS, MATLAB, ImageJ, and Microsoft Office.
Excellent attention to detail, accurate data entry and analysis. Required Ability to complete tasks in an orderly and timely fashion.
Ability to work on several projects simultaneously and to switch focus as needed. Required Skill in writing clear and concise correspondence
Ability to effectively handle and restrain mice; knowledge of rodent anatomy. Required Knowledge of the adipose field, including relevant experimental techniques and literature.
